title: Kamailio – Ansible Role
html:
Ansible is a system for rapid deployment of services. Alberto Llamas has shared a link to his Ansible Kamailio Role that could be used as starting point for many people when deploying their Kamailio:

  • https://galaxy.ansible.com/albertollamaso/Ansible-kamailio-role/

Over the time there were other people sharing similar resources, such as the one in the article:

  • Kamailio HA with Ansible, Corosync and Pacemaker

We welcome any resource, blog post or tools that make it easier to deploy and work with Kamailio and gladly publish news about them. Should you have or know such resource, do not hesitate to contact us!

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
